name: Mayer-Salovey-Caruso Emotional Intelligence Test (MSCEIT)
description: An ability-based EI test measuring four branches: perceiving, using, understanding, and managing emotions. Uses consensus and expert scoring rather than self-report.
reputation: Most psychometrically rigorous EI measure; distinguishes EI as ability vs. self-report trait.
notes: Consensus scoring method questioned; requires licensed administrator; relatively rare in practice.
